query_text: Our beloved colleague Stephen is now leaving the company. He is one of the best engineers we had. He used to love posting memes. Write a short, fun and inspiring goodbye message.

content.text:
Here's a short, fun, and inspiring goodbye message for Stephen:

---

🎉 **So long, Stephen — the legend leaves the building!** 🎉

They say the best engineers don't just fix problems — they **make you wonder how you ever survived without them.** That was you, Stephen. 💡

From debugging code at lightning speed ⚡ to blessing our Slack channels with the *finest* meme collection known to mankind 🐸😂, you made every day at work a little brighter and a LOT more entertaining.

As you close this chapter and open an exciting new one, remember:

> *"Great engineers don't just build systems — they build people up."*
> And you, my friend, did both beautifully. 🙌

May your next adventure be **bug-free, meme-filled, and absolutely legendary.** 🚀

We'll miss your genius, your humor, and yes — **even those memes at 9 AM on a Monday.** 😄

**Go show the world what we already know — you're one of a kind!**

Wishing you all the best, always. 💙

*— Your [Company Name] Family* 👨‍💻👩‍💻

---

Feel free to customize the company name or add any personal touches! 😊
